This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is the first bail application filed by applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No. 409/2022, registered at Police Station-Chhapara, District Seoni (MP) for the offence under Sections 366, 376 and 376(2)(n) of Indian Penal Code.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is under arrest since 14.11.2022.
Prosecutrix in the case is aged about 19 years.
Applicant is also a young boy aged about 24 years.
Prosecutrix is not turning up in Court to give evidence.
In these circumstances, applicant may be released on bail.
3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for State opposed the bail application.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5.

Considering the age of prosecutrix, period of custody of applicant and fact that prosecutrix is not turning up in Court to give evidence, without commenting on the merits of the case, bail application Lekhram @ Jheenu vs State Of M.P. on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/152214871/
1 filed by the applicant is allowed.
